groups.meta: 365,000 standing total to Exalted plus the bow
groups.mode: leave around round 8 for one clean daily cap

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Revered, 3 at Rank 5 Exalted

conditions: Below Neutral, standing alone won't climb you out: each negative rank has its own sacrifice.
Rank-ups also cost 940,000 credits in total. Standing past a rank's maximum is lost, so rank up before your next mission.

disclosures.title: why 365,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to Exalted (5,000 / 22,000 / 44,000 / 70,000 / 99,000). Exalted's bar holds 132,000, enough to bank the 125,000-standing purchase.

conditions: The free item you pick at each rank-up can never be a Syndicate weapon; the bow is always a separate 125,000-standing purchase.
Mastery Rank 12 is required both to buy it and to receive it in a trade.
bonuses: Rakta Ballistica and Rakta Dark Dagger sell for the same standing from the same rank; staying pledged is the cheapest route to all three.
